meta.description: Mec item stat boosts for the save viewer's body profile
meta.excluded: 0xF0-0xFF key items: not equippable, and the chart omits them.
meta.name_note: name is the guide's spelling, kept for auditing. The viewer displays the resources.assets spelling from constants.json.
meta.null_note: null means the chart prints a dash: the item gives no boost to that stat. hp and tot are null when the chart prints ---.
meta.race_note: This is the Mec column only (ITEMD03). Human, Mystic and Monster records use different boost tables (ITEMD02) and must not read these values.
